name: PrizePicks API
description: Independent developer data service. New accounts use weighted credits: Free 100/month, Developer 10000/month at $49, Production 50000/month at $149, Scale 250000/month at $499. Paid subscriptions on an older request contract keep it; Free accounts on an older allowance move to 100 credits at the 1 December 2026 reset (00:00 UTC). See /credits for endpoint costs and /api/v1/credit-costs for quotes. Responses report X-Usage-Unit, X-Credits-Cost, X-Credits-Remaining and X-Quota-Reset. Live endpoints require an account-issued bearer key. Public /demo endpoints contain fictional, fixed-date fixtures. No official settlement dataset is currently exposed. All nullable values represent unknown or unavailable source information. Plans: the live board is full on every plan. On Free, line history, /changes, /board as_of, /results and imported lines reach back 7 days; /game-logs, /team-stats and /opponent-stats cover the last 10 games per player or team with no season-wide reads; /hit-rates counts the last 10 games; /training-set is one page of up to 100 rows; /compare as_of and closing prices are off; /export is current lines. A limited answer keeps its real rows and adds meta.plan_limit (feature, limit, unlocks, price_usd_per_month, upgrade_url, message); CSV responses carry X-Plan-Limit and X-Upgrade-Url headers. Developer, Production and Scale have no such limits.
